<span id="5d54070a"></span>
# Feature Overview

The system has built\-in lightweight data cleaning and visual modeling capabilities, and supports adding data processing nodes in the form of drag and drop to filter, deduplicate, and replace data. After data cleaning is completed, the processed data can be output to the target source, reducing the cost of deep data governance.

At the same time, the visual modeling ability can also help personnel with the development foundation to conduct data modeling work, such as user intention prediction, and use machine learning to calculate the user's car purchase intention. In addition, the system also provides Catboost classification, K\-Means clustering, decision tree regression, ARIMA model and other diverse machine learning operators to help users complete data modeling work.

<span id="b344f6f8"></span>
# Usage restrictions


* Users need to have **project editing** rights or **visual modeling module view/new task** permission to use this feature.

* Some of the features in visual modeling are **paid capabilities** , please contact your commercial manager if necessary


<span id="e3417b9f"></span>
# Core function


|**function name** |**Function Description** |
|---|---|
|Visual modeling capabilities |* Offline visual modeling tasks:<br><br>   * Data cleaning: support "field settings", "IDMapping" operators, etc<br><br>   * Output node: supports "output", "output label" operators, etc<br><br>* Real\-time visual modeling tasks:<br><br>   * Data cleaning: support "field settings", "IDMapping" operators, etc<br><br>   * Output node: supports "output label", "output dataset" operator, etc |
|data cleaning operator |Support data cleaning operators such as filtering rows, adding calculated columns, joining, merging, transposing, splitting fields, etc |
|external output operator |Provide an external output operator to support the output of processed data to external storage, thus realizing the construction of data asset output capabilities. |
|Unstructured data processing operator |Support text processing, document processing, audio processing, image processing, video processing, vectorization model, large model inference and other operators. |


<span id="1ca8c679"></span>
# Term explanation


* **Data modeling:**  The process of cleaning, processing and producing the original data source according to some data processing logic is called data modeling

* **Data connection:**  Build configuration capabilities that connect with various data sources and realize the primary function of data reading

* **Canvas:**  Assemble functional modules into a visual effect of data processing flow according to a directed flow

* **Operator** : The ability to integrate data reading, processing, algorithms, and data output capabilities in the canvas, corresponding to each square in the canvas

* **Connection: A** directed relationship between operators that refers to a channel for data flow between two operators

* **Real\-time task: The** data source data is a visual modeling task that is updated in real time and the data stream is processed in real time

* **Offline tasks:**  The data source data is updated at the level of days/hours (that is, updated daily/hourly), and the data flow processing process is a visual modeling task that is performed regularly or manually


<span id="549b77f0"></span>
# Application scenario

<span id="7686a959"></span>
## Visual data cleaning is more efficient

In the early stages of data analytics, it is often necessary to clean and process the original data source, including removing duplicate data, processing missing and outliers, and transforming the data. Through visual modeling, users can intuitively formulate data cleaning rules and view cleaning results in real time on the visual interface, improving data quality and laying a good foundation for subsequent analysis.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/0ae5bf93fbee40e7838406ddbddad140~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

For example, a large amount of behavioral data is obtained during customer research, but not so much data is required for actual analysis. Therefore, it is hoped that the data will be sampled and analyzed to ensure the uniformity of the sampling results. It is hoped that a certain proportion of data will be extracted according to different ages. Classified sampling can be performed through a "stratified sampling" operator. For example, 50% of the data is extracted according to the "age" setting based on the sample data for sampling analysis. Only 50% of the remaining data will be output and applied to subsequent operators.

<span id="fa7bdcb4"></span>
## AI operators assist in data mining and data intelligence

The visual modeling function module encapsulates more than 30 common AI operator capabilities. By understanding the function of the algorithm, you can configure the input and training objectives of the algorithm operator in a visual way, complete the model training, and quickly obtain the prediction results according to the other data content configured, so as to support business goals such as decision\-making, optimization, and prediction.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/4618ee2124364d9f92c5ef042539c5ba~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

For example, using clustering operators to automate customer layering by analyzing multiple attributes of the customer, including the customer's birthday, warranty count, and the number of Mini Program openings last month. Users can set the number of target categories to build a training model. Once the model is trained, it is possible to classify the entire amount of data to be predicted by adding AI predictors. The prediction results will generate a new field "prediction user category", which is used to represent the category to which each user belongs. Users with the same predicted value will be classified into the same category. Helping enterprises better understand their customer base and achieve more accurate market segmentation and personalized service.

<span id="79f9cb73"></span>
## Unstructured data processing unleashes dormant knowledge assets

The visual knowledge processing function has built\-in a variety of unstructured data processing capabilities. Only by understanding the processing target can the input source and extraction rules of the parsing operator be configured visually to complete the automatic cleaning and structured transformation of PDF, Word, pictures, videos, web pages and other types of unstructured data, so as to support knowledge sedimentation, content retrieval, intelligent Q & A and other business goals.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/ec3064e3ca8a435d9a73ffa0c9b38a33~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

For example, using image OCR processing operators to automate compliance audits of e\-commerce materials. By analyzing multiple visual elements in marketing posters, including brand logos, spokesperson portraits, promotional interest points, and sensitive word information. Users can create automated processing models by setting their own risk labels to be identified. Help enterprises quickly locate illegal content in massive visual materials, significantly improve content management efficiency and avoid brand compliance risks.

<span id="6acbeaa1"></span>
## Encryption and decryption operators ensure data security

In order to protect users' sensitive credit score data, such as age, gender, salary, and marital status, they need to encrypt this information after it is connected to the platform. The encryption process uses a key generated by the platform to ensure that only the user knows how to decrypt it. This way, even if the data is stored in encrypted form, it does not affect statistical analysis. When you need to draw a user portrait using plaintext data, you can decrypt the encrypted data through a specific decryption operator, and the decryption process can be done through the built\-in function of the system or by manually entering the key.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/e128a10e1e9146388f53a5e9a3c40c45~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

<span id="4d357fe4"></span>
# **Usage flow**

Create Visual Modeling Task \-\- \> Select Data Connection \-\- \> Add Data Operator \-\- \> Configure Operator Connection Relationship \-\- \> Configure Operator \-\- \> Execute Operator \-\- \> Output Operator \-\- \> Set the storage method of the output operator.
